name: SQL Injection
description: Unsanitized user input concatenated into SQL queries
trigger_keywords: sql query select insert update delete execute
fix_pattern: Use parameterized queries / prepared statements

name: Command Injection
description: User input passed to OS shell commands
trigger_keywords: exec shell spawn system popen subprocess os.system
fix_pattern: Validate input strictly; use subprocess with list args not shell=True

name: XSS (Cross-Site Scripting)
description: Untrusted data rendered in browser without escaping
trigger_keywords: innerHTML innerText dangerouslySetInnerHTML document.write render html
fix_pattern: Escape output; use Content-Security-Policy; use safe DOM APIs

name: Hardcoded Secrets
description: API keys / passwords / tokens written directly in source code
trigger_keywords: api_key secret password token private_key credential apikey
fix_pattern: Use environment variables and secret managers; never commit secrets

name: Broken Authentication
description: Weak or missing authentication mechanisms
trigger_keywords: login auth session jwt token cookie password
fix_pattern: Use bcrypt/argon2 for passwords; implement MFA; secure session management

name: Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR)
description: Direct use of user-supplied IDs to access resources without authorization check
trigger_keywords: user_id account_id file_id record_id order_id
fix_pattern: Validate ownership on every request; use indirect reference maps

name: Path Traversal
description: User input used to construct file paths
trigger_keywords: open read write file path directory upload download
fix_pattern: Sanitize path; use realpath; whitelist allowed directories

name: Insecure Deserialization
description: Untrusted data deserialized without validation
trigger_keywords: pickle load deserialize unserialize yaml.load json.loads
fix_pattern: Never deserialize untrusted data; use safe loaders (yaml.safe_load)

name: Missing Rate Limiting
description: No throttle on sensitive endpoints allowing brute force
trigger_keywords: login register password reset api endpoint
fix_pattern: Implement layered rate limits, abuse detection, and step-up challenges where appropriate

name: Sensitive Data in Logs
description: Passwords / tokens / PII written to logs
trigger_keywords: log print console.log logger debug info error
fix_pattern: Mask/redact sensitive fields before logging; use structured logging

name: JWT Vulnerabilities
description: Weak JWT implementation (none algorithm, weak secret, no expiry)
trigger_keywords: jwt token verify sign decode
fix_pattern: Pin allowed algorithms; validate signature, issuer, audience, and expiry; rotate keys

name: CSRF (Cross-Site Request Forgery)
description: State-changing requests not protected by CSRF tokens
trigger_keywords: form post delete update submit
fix_pattern: Use CSRF tokens (SameSite cookies + CSRF middleware)

name: Mass Assignment
description: Binding user-supplied data directly to model without whitelist
trigger_keywords: params update create assign attributes request.body
fix_pattern: Use allowlist (permit/whitelist) for mass assignment; never bind all params

name: Weak Cryptography
description: Using MD5/SHA1/DES/RC4 for sensitive data
trigger_keywords: md5 sha1 des rc4 base64 encode hash encrypt
fix_pattern: Use AES-256-GCM / bcrypt / argon2 / SHA-256+; never use MD5/SHA1 for passwords

name: Open Redirect
description: Redirecting to user-supplied URLs without validation
trigger_keywords: redirect url return_url next callback
fix_pattern: Whitelist allowed redirect URLs; validate against allowed domains

name: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)
description: Server fetches URLs supplied by user
trigger_keywords: fetch request url http get post
fix_pattern: Allowlist destinations and schemes; resolve and validate every redirect/IP; block private, loopback, link-local, and metadata ranges

name: Prototype Pollution
description: Merging user-supplied objects pollutes Object prototype
trigger_keywords: merge assign extend deepmerge lodash
fix_pattern: Use Object.create(null); validate keys; use safe merge libraries

name: ReDoS (Regex DoS)
description: Catastrophic backtracking in regular expressions vulnerable to crafted input
trigger_keywords: regex regexp match test exec
fix_pattern: Audit regex for nested quantifiers; use timeout; use safe-regex linter

name: Insecure File Upload
description: File uploads without type/size/content validation
trigger_keywords: upload file multer formdata
fix_pattern: Validate MIME type + extension + magic bytes; scan with AV; store outside webroot

name: Missing Security Headers
description: HTTP responses missing security headers (CSP / HSTS / X-Frame-Options)
trigger_keywords: express app response headers middleware
fix_pattern: Add Helmet.js / Security headers middleware; configure CSP / HSTS / X-Frame-Options

name: Software Supply Chain Failure
description: Malicious or compromised dependencies build systems or package repositories
trigger_keywords: npm pip install dependency package require import gem composer
fix_pattern: Pin & verify dependency hashes; use lockfiles; SCA scanning; verify package signatures; audit transitive deps

name: Mishandling of Exceptional Conditions
description: Improper error handling logic errors and fail-open scenarios that leak info or bypass controls
trigger_keywords: try catch except error exception finally throw
fix_pattern: Fail closed (deny by default); generic error messages in prod; never expose stack traces; handle all error paths

name: Security Misconfiguration
description: Default credentials open ports verbose errors unnecessary features enabled
trigger_keywords: config env debug default settings cors permissions
fix_pattern: Harden defaults; disable debug in prod; least-functionality; review CORS; automated config scanning

name: Prompt Injection (LLM)
description: Malicious input manipulates LLM behavior to bypass system prompts or exfiltrate data
trigger_keywords: llm openai anthropic prompt gpt claude chat ai agent completion
fix_pattern: Treat all LLM input as untrusted; separate instructions from data; least-privilege tools; human-in-loop for high-risk actions; output filtering

name: Insecure LLM Output Handling
description: LLM output used downstream without sanitization causing XSS or RCE
trigger_keywords: llm output render eval exec response generated completion
fix_pattern: Never trust LLM output; sanitize before rendering or executing; treat as untrusted user input; validate structured output

name: Excessive Agency (LLM)
description: LLM agent granted too much functionality permission or autonomy
trigger_keywords: agent tool function autonomous plugin action mcp
fix_pattern: Least-privilege tooling; scoped credentials per user; human approval for high-impact actions; limit autonomous execution

name: Sensitive Information Disclosure (LLM)
description: LLM leaks PII secrets or training data in responses
trigger_keywords: llm pii secret training data leak disclosure context
fix_pattern: Scrub PII from prompts/context; restrict data in system prompt; output filtering; never put secrets in prompts

name: Broken Object Level Authorization (API)
description: API endpoint exposes object without verifying caller can access that specific object
trigger_keywords: api endpoint object id resource get fetch
fix_pattern: Verify object ownership on every request; never trust client-supplied IDs; use authorization middleware

name: Broken Function Level Authorization (API)
description: API allows access to admin or privileged functions without role check
trigger_keywords: api admin role function privilege endpoint method
fix_pattern: Enforce RBAC per endpoint; deny by default; separate admin routes; verify role on every privileged action

name: Unrestricted Resource Consumption (API)
description: API has no limits on payload size requests or compute allowing DoS or cost explosion
trigger_keywords: api request payload size limit rate batch query
fix_pattern: Rate limit; payload size caps; pagination limits; query depth limits (GraphQL); timeout enforcement

name: XML External Entity (XXE)
description: XML parser processes external entity references leading to file disclosure or SSRF
trigger_keywords: xml parse parser dom soap xxe entity
fix_pattern: Disable DTD/external entity processing in XML parsers; use JSON where possible; use defusedxml in Python

name: Insufficient Logging & Monitoring
description: Security events not logged or monitored delaying breach detection
trigger_keywords: log monitor audit event detect alert
fix_pattern: Log auth/access/admin events; centralize logs; alert on anomalies; protect log integrity; never log secrets

name: Race Condition / TOCTOU
description: Time-of-check to time-of-use gap allows state manipulation (e.g. double-spend)
trigger_keywords: concurrent async transaction balance check update lock
fix_pattern: Use atomic operations; database transactions with locks; idempotency keys; optimistic/pessimistic locking

name: Insecure Cookie Configuration
description: Cookies missing HttpOnly Secure or SameSite flags
trigger_keywords: cookie session set-cookie samesite
fix_pattern: Set HttpOnly + Secure + SameSite=Strict/Lax on all sensitive cookies; scope domain & path

name: Container & Cloud Misconfiguration
description: Containers running as root exposed secrets overly permissive IAM open storage buckets
trigger_keywords: docker kubernetes k8s container cloud s3 iam bucket
fix_pattern: Run as non-root; least-privilege IAM; scan images; no secrets in images; private buckets by default

name: Broken API Authentication
description: API authentication tokens or credential recovery flows are weak or improperly validated
trigger_keywords: api authentication bearer token credential recovery login
fix_pattern: Use mature authentication libraries; validate token issuer audience expiry and signature; protect recovery and MFA flows

name: Broken Object Property Level Authorization
description: API exposes or accepts object properties the caller is not allowed to access or modify
trigger_keywords: api property field object response mass assignment
fix_pattern: Use explicit request and response schemas; enforce property-level authorization; allowlist writable fields

name: Unrestricted Access to Sensitive Business Flows
description: Automated abuse of business workflows such as purchases reservations or account creation
trigger_keywords: api business flow automation bot purchase reservation signup
fix_pattern: Model abuse cases; apply business limits, bot defenses, anomaly detection, and step-up verification

name: Improper API Inventory Management
description: Undocumented deprecated or test API versions remain exposed
trigger_keywords: api inventory version deprecated shadow endpoint
fix_pattern: Maintain an API inventory and ownership; retire old versions; block test and debug endpoints in production

name: Unsafe Consumption of APIs
description: Data from third-party APIs is trusted without validation or resource limits
trigger_keywords: api third-party upstream integration response
fix_pattern: Validate upstream data; enforce timeouts and size limits; use TLS; isolate and monitor third-party integrations

name: Data and Model Poisoning (LLM)
description: Manipulated training fine-tuning or retrieval data changes model behavior or outputs
trigger_keywords: llm model poison training fine-tune rag dataset
fix_pattern: Track data provenance; validate and version datasets; restrict contributors; evaluate models and retrieval corpora before release

name: System Prompt Leakage (LLM)
description: System prompts or hidden instructions disclose secrets controls or sensitive implementation details
trigger_keywords: llm system prompt leak hidden instruction
fix_pattern: Do not place secrets or authorization logic in prompts; assume prompts may be disclosed; enforce controls outside the model

name: Vector and Embedding Weaknesses (LLM)
description: Weak tenant isolation or untrusted retrieval content causes disclosure or manipulated results
trigger_keywords: llm rag vector embedding retrieval tenant
fix_pattern: Enforce tenant-aware authorization on retrieval; validate sources; isolate indexes; treat retrieved content as untrusted

name: Misinformation (LLM)
description: Confident but incorrect model output causes unsafe decisions or actions
trigger_keywords: llm misinformation hallucination factual decision
fix_pattern: Ground high-impact answers in trusted sources; expose uncertainty; require verification or human review

name: Unbounded Consumption (LLM)
description: Unrestricted model requests context or agent loops cause denial of service or excessive cost
trigger_keywords: llm token context loop cost denial wallet
fix_pattern: Set token, cost, concurrency, recursion, and timeout budgets; monitor and terminate abnormal workloads

name: LLM Supply Chain Risk
description: Compromised models adapters datasets plugins or dependencies introduce malicious behavior
trigger_keywords: llm model adapter dataset plugin supply chain
fix_pattern: Verify provenance and integrity; pin artifacts; scan dependencies; evaluate third-party models and plugins

name: API Security Misconfiguration
description: Insecure defaults CORS methods debug output or transport configuration expose APIs
trigger_keywords: api cors debug method configuration tls
fix_pattern: Harden API gateways and services; restrict methods and CORS; disable debug; automate configuration testing

name: API Server-Side Request Forgery
description: API fetches a user-controlled URL without validating the destination
trigger_keywords: api ssrf webhook url fetch callback
fix_pattern: Allowlist destinations and schemes; block internal and metadata networks; validate redirects and DNS resolution

name: Server-Side Template Injection (SSTI)
description: User-controlled input rendered as template source executes attacker-controlled template expressions or server-side code
trigger_keywords: template ssti jinja2 twig pebble mako freemarker velocity ejs pug nunjucks render_template_string expression engine
fix_pattern: Never compile or render untrusted data as template source; use static named templates and pass untrusted data only as values; use restricted or sandboxed engines only as defense in depth

name: NoSQL Injection
description: Untrusted input changes NoSQL query logic, operators, scripts, or filters and can cause authentication bypass or data exfiltration
trigger_keywords: nosql nosqli mongodb mongoose elasticsearch redis cassandra document collection query operator filter script
fix_pattern: Define typed allowlist request schemas and construct queries server-side; never accept client-supplied query objects, operators, scripts, or filters; use least-privilege data-store accounts
